prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a children's first-person meadow game, HuggingDOOM — Honey & Hugs. Generate a SINGLE square transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equally sized square cells. NO grid lines, NO letters, NO text. Each sprite entirely contained in its cell with generous transparent margins, identical scale and ground baseline. A consistent adorable chubby golden-yellow bear, rounded plush proportions, tiny rounded ears, cream muzzle and tummy, friendly dark eyes, pink tongue and blush, polished hand-painted 3D cartoon children's game art. Front-facing or very slight 3/4 view, camera level, full body and feet always visible. Row 1: four different waddling walk-cycle poses A B C D, bear approaching viewer licking lips in friendly anticipation. Row 2: first two poses eagerly licking lips, third comical open-mouth CHOMP without scary teeth, fourth impatient foot-tapping with paws on hips. Row 3: first pose enormous excited eyes catching a golden honeycomb; second pose sitting on a small red gingham picnic blanket eating honeycomb happily with tiny cream bib and crumbs; third same seated eating bear chewing with eyes closed; fourth blushing bear arms open wide to hug the viewer, red hearts above head. Row 4: first pose sitting peacefully with huge red floating heart, second same sitting peaceful bear eyes closed, third seated bear holding emergency honeycomb triumphantly with amused face, fourth seated bear content happy smile. Transparent background in all cells; no scenery, no floor, no shadows outside sprites, no weapons, no blood, no aggression. High readability when reduced to 96 pixel sprites. Keep all hearts, blankets, and feet within own cell. Exact regular 4x4 atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exact 2 by 2 environment texture atlas for a bright children's first-person meadow game. Square image divided into FOUR EXACTLY EQUAL square quadrants, no gutters, no frames, no labels, no text. Soft hand-painted cartoon game texture, sunny yellow-green meadow palette, sky blue, creamy white and pink daisies, inviting natural beauty. TOP LEFT: seamless repeatable overhead close view of lush short green meadow grass, subtle blades, scattered small pink white yellow flowers, uniformly lit, no perspective. TOP RIGHT: seamless repeatable dense leafy green hedge, front view, rounded layered leaves and tiny blossoms, no sky, no ground, no perspective. BOTTOM LEFT: soft blue summer sky with fluffy white clouds, NO ground or horizon, airy and mostly blue, suited to panoramic sky texture. BOTTOM RIGHT: beautiful wide-feeling sunny meadow landscape with rolling hills, tiny distant trees, wildflower grass in foreground and bright sky, storybook scenic backdrop. No bears, humans, animals, buildings, weapons, text or watermarks. Four full-bleed square texture panels, perfectly aligned 2x2; maintain distinct quadrants for machine slicing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FOUR game props in a perfectly regular 2 columns x 2 rows transparent square texture atlas for a friendly children's first-person game. No grid lines, no text or labels. Same soft plush storybook 3D hand-painted style as a yellow teddy bear meadow. Each subject fully inside its own equal square cell, ample transparent margins. TOP LEFT: first-person view of two rounded soft cream mittens cradling a golden honeycomb in a small wooden scoop, arms extend from bottom corners, pointed forward toward the viewer's center of view. This is a silly honey tosser, absolutely no pistol, no trigger, no metal, no weapon shape. TOP RIGHT: first-person view of two huge soft cream plush arms opening wide for an embrace, open round mitten palms at left and right, broad U-shaped empty transparent space in the middle, arms extend from bottom corners; inviting cuddly hug gesture. BOTTOM LEFT: a small isolated cluster of pink white yellow daisies with green stems, leaves and a tuft of grass, straight-on view at grass level, suitable as a 32-pixel billboard decoration. BOTTOM RIGHT: a single delicious hexagonal golden honeycomb with visible honey cells and one tiny golden dripping drop, centered. True transparent background throughout, no scenery, no shadows outside the objects, no humans or bears, no weapons. Clean silhouette readable at small size.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached single game sprite of a happy chubby yellow bear sitting on a red gingham picnic blanket and eating a honeycomb. Remove ONLY the cream bib and its honeycomb emblem: replace that area with the bear's normal soft cream tummy fur. Preserve the bear's face, pose, paws, feet, honeycomb, flying crumbs, body proportions, red blanket, colors, lighting and soft cartoon 3D art style. Preserve whole sprite framing and transparent background. No other changes, no new objects, no letters or text. Output a single isolated full-body game sprite on genuine transparent background.
